$comment: Categories, business details and before/after pairs. The services themselves — names and prices — live in Sanity (`service` documents) and are edited in /admin; this file no longer lists them. Prices are in DOP, per session.
$imageNote: Photos live in the public Supabase bucket `yai-beauty`, not /public. A service's photo is its Sanity document's `image` field, a path inside the bucket (e.g. salon-areas/service-acne.webp).
$resultsNote: Before/after pairs, read from treatments/<service>/before.webp and after.webp in the bucket. `consent` is the date the client signed written permission (YYYY-MM-DD): production builds skip a pair without one, while `next dev` shows them all. `layout` is "stacked" (before above after) or "split" (side by side); `focus` is the CSS object-position both halves crop to.
